## Summary

Implemented F002 of plan 2026-05-01-001-feat-onboarding-ux: a new `dispatch-from-plan <plan-id>` CLI subcommand in `scripts/jarvis_orchestrate/cli.py` that is a strict dry-run by default (always prints the 10-field pre-flight block — `plan_path`, `feature`, `tier`, `target_env`, `target_project`, `implementer`, `auditor`, `human_gates`, `max_iterations`, `quota_readiness` — and exits 0 regardless of TTY) and only commits to dispatch when `--confirm` is passed.

The readiness label is computed via `_compute_readiness()` which calls `circuit_breakers.collect_agent_coverage` per resolved (impl, auditor) agent, mapping the structured outcomes onto the five required states `{ok, config_required, calibration_required, unit_mismatch, missing_state}` (with a `claude=N% / codex=N%` summary line under `ok`).
